# Clipboard Drop

> Send copied text via AirDrop from the macOS menu bar.

Clipboard Drop is a lightweight macOS menu bar app that reads clipboard text, writes it to a temporary file (.txt, .md, or .url), and hands it to AirDrop for quick transfer to nearby Apple devices.

## Use case

Universal Clipboard requires the same Apple ID and Handoff enabled on both devices. Clipboard Drop works with any nearby AirDrop-capable device regardless of account — useful for sending links, commands, code snippets, or notes across different Apple IDs.

## Key facts

- macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- Menu bar app (no Dock icon)
- Sends text and HTTP/HTTPS URLs
- Output formats: .txt, .md, .url (configurable)
- Receiver needs no app installed — only AirDrop
- Clipboard history is in-memory only, cleared on quit
- No cloud sync, no accounts, no servers, no data collection
- Open source, MIT licensed
- Built with Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit

## Architecture

- App/: SwiftUI app entry, NSApplicationDelegate, controller
- Features/: menu bar popover UI, settings UI
- Platform/: NSPasteboard monitoring, NSSharingService AirDrop bridge
- Shared/: app config, design tokens, send preferences
